cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Talk Around the Mess
cards.instruction: Keep attention on minor details so no one addresses the larger responsibility you avoided.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved this spoon for Mum's lunch. You may inspect the shine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we do the kitchen now? You haven't cleaned it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Kitchen inspection begins with cutlery. You may check the forks while I finish this spoon.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've asked Mum to bring rubber gloves and help you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Her assistance is approved. You may select a guest towel first; I won't authorize her drying her hands on that faded stripe.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 authorizes only cutlery inspection in response to kitchen cleaning; A5 grants assistance only after another minor towel decision.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 neglected kitchen causes A3 fork diversion; B4 gloved helper causes A5 preparation of a guest towel instead of tackling the larger duty.

relationship.evidence: B2 asks to address real work and B4 arranges help, so A must redirect an actual solution.

heightening.evidence: B4 helper arrival threatens to force cleaning; A5 uses the helper needs to create another small inspection.
